name: 11726 · Copiague, NY
findings: ZIP 11726 (Copiague) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11726 (Copiague) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
